tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use semantic versioning (semver) for version numbers, because it is clearer about what consumers can expect from a release.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
tool_input.description: Create the version scheme policy file

result:
I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is semantic versioning (semver), because it is clearer about what consumers can expect from a release. It does not mention the earlier calver choice, which that decision replaced.

The only later revocation on record (#27) concerns build verification, not versioning, so the semver decision (#21) still stands.

The first attempt to create the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the file-write tool instead. I did not read the file back afterwards.
